case_studies.abstract: As modern microservice systems grow increasingly complex due to dynamic interactions and evolving runtime environments, they experience failures with rising frequency. case_studies.title: MetaBackdoor: Exploiting Positional Encoding as a Backdoor Attack Surface in LLMs

The result shows that this type of attack can be effective without requiring explicit modification of the input text.

case_studies.summary: This research solves the problem of large language models being unable to incorporate new knowledge after pretraining, by building a modular framework called MeMo that encodes new knowledge into a dedicated memory model, resulting in more efficient and accurate updates.
